headline: Deepak Fertilizers appoints Pankaj Gupta as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
hook: New compliance head at Deepak Fertilizers
summary: Deepak Fertilizers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited announced the appointment of Mr Pankaj Gupta as its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The appointment is effective from November 01, 2026. This is a routine administrative change in key managerial personnel for the listed chemical manufacturer. Indian retail investors are largely unaffected by standard compliance officer appointments.
why_it_matters: Routine management filing with no financial impact

headline: Four Nifty 500 stocks cross above VWAP indicator on strong intraday buying
hook: Technical buying strength in four Nifty 500 stocks
summary: Four Nifty 500 companies—Clean Max, Belrise Industries, TBO Tek, and Deepak Fertilisers—closed above their Volume-Weighted Average Price on October 6. Crossing above the VWAP line indicates that these stocks traded at prices higher than their intraday average relative to total volume. The price action signals underlying intraday buying demand and positive price momentum across these counters. Technical traders frequently monitor VWAP crossovers to identify short-term bullish momentum.
why_it_matters: Signals short-term technical buying strength in four midcap stock counters.
